title: Torn Ledger Page
text:
...received from the Dyers' Quarter: 40 lb madder root, 12 lb woad, 3 lb saffron (confiscated), for rendering.

Received from Brinewell: 2 tons saltpetre, for the Vault.

Issued to the Belfry: 1 hammer, iron. 1 bell-ringer, reassigned.

The rest of the page has been torn out and, from the look of the edge, eaten.
